title: The Man Who Sold the Eiffel Tower

shots.line: In 1925, a man in Paris sold the Eiffel Tower.
shots.scene: establishing wide: Paris street at night, the lit Eiffel Tower behind the rooftops; Lustig (red tie, fedora) by the café presents the tower on "sold" and smirks; PARIS 1925 readout on "1925"; slow push

shots.line: All seven thousand three hundred tons of iron.
shots.scene: low angle close on one leg of the tower: riveted iron girders and X-bracing lit by its lamps, camera tilts up the leg; gold readout counts 0 -> 7,300 TONS from "seven" to "tons"

shots.line: The buyer was a scrap-metal dealer named André Poisson.
shots.scene: establishing wide: Poisson's scrapyard at dusk, scrap piles and a crane arm against an orange sky, Poisson (yellow cap) proud with crossed arms; callout ANDRE POISSON / SCRAP-METAL DEALER on "Poisson"; slow drift

shots.line: The tower was never for sale.
shots.scene: TIME FREEZE two-shot under the street lamp: Poisson hands Lustig a fat envelope, banknotes hang frozen in the air, cool tint, slow roll; only Lustig moves: turns his head to camera and smirks on "never"; coral badge NOT FOR SALE on "sale"

shots.line: And when Poisson found out,
shots.scene: giant face Poisson, neutral -> shocked on "found out"; blurred dark scrapyard behind; slow push

shots.line: he didn't go to the police.
shots.scene: wide, night, rain: police station front with the POLICE lamp and double doors; Poisson walks in from the left and stops at the foot of the steps on "didn't", looking up at the door

shots.line: He was too embarrassed.
shots.scene: medium in the rain: Poisson turns away from the station, facepalm, nervous, then walks off left; the lit door blurred behind

shots.line: So the con man left the country...
shots.scene: night station platform: the train pulls out to the left, Lustig at a lit compartment window tips his hat, steam lit by the platform lamps; readout -> AUSTRIA

shots.line: and later, he came back to try it again.
shots.scene: Paris street again (callback to s001): Lustig walks in from the right with a suitcase, sets it down, looks up at the tower and tips his hat on "again"

shots.line: How do you sell a landmark you don't own,
shots.scene: wide: the tower alone over the rooftops at night, a giant paper price tag swings from the first platform, a gold "?" on it; slow push

shots.line: to a man who buys scrap for a living?
shots.scene: medium, scrapyard at dusk: Poisson drops an iron plate onto the platform scale on "scrap", the needle swings, he nods

shots.line: It took three tricks.
shots.scene: top-down: a dark table in one light pool; a hand deals three gold cards numbered 1, 2, 3 face up, one per beat ("three", between, "tricks"), each with a "?"

shots.line: And here's the part that should worry you.
shots.scene: 2025: YOU on the couch in a dark living room, the phone the only light (cool glow on the face); the phone buzzes on "worry", YOU looks down, worried

shots.line: In 2025, people told the FTC they lost about
shots.scene: insert: the phone in YOU's hand, a message with a government-style seal, URGENT and PAY NOW; readout 2025 on "2025"

shots.line: nine hundred and twenty million dollars to scammers pretending to be the government.
shots.scene: data card over the blurred room: counter $0 -> $920 MILLION from "nine" to "dollars" in coral, label LOST TO GOVERNMENT IMPOSTERS, source FTC 2025

shots.line: The same three tricks.
shots.scene: top-down: the three gold cards again on the table, now a smartphone lies beside them, its screen lights the cards; slow rotate

shots.line: By the end of this video, you'll spot all three.
shots.scene: giant face YOU lit by the phone, worried -> determined on "spot"; three small gold cards pop beside the head on "all three"

shots.line: Picture it in Tilltown.
shots.scene: 3D: Tilltown main street at golden hour, low-poly shops with lit windows, the clock tower at the end; camera glides down the street toward the junk shop; TILLTOWN readout

shots.line: A letter lands on the junk dealer's counter.
shots.scene: junk shop inside, warm: shelves of old lamps, clocks and wheels, the dealer (green beanie) behind the counter; a courier's hand drops a letter on the counter on "lands", the dealer looks down, surprised

shots.line: Heavy paper.
shots.scene: insert: the dealer's hands lift the thick cream envelope, it barely bends

shots.line: The mayor's own seal.
shots.scene: macro: the red wax seal with a gold clock-tower crest, a glint sweeps across on "seal"; slow push

shots.line: "The old clock tower is coming down.
shots.scene: low angle: Tilltown's clock tower at dusk, pigeons; the camera tilts down from the clock face to the street on "coming down"

shots.line: You have been chosen to bid."
shots.scene: giant face DEALER, surprised -> joy on "chosen", warm gold glow

shots.line: Would you argue with the mayor's seal?
shots.scene: over the shoulder: the dealer's blurred beanie and shoulder in the foreground, the letter and its glowing seal sharp in his hands, the clock tower in the window behind

shots.line: That's exactly what Victor Lustig built.
shots.scene: giant face Lustig half in shadow, the Paris night bokeh behind; smirk on "built"; callout VICTOR LUSTIG on "Victor Lustig"

shots.line: He read in the papers that the Eiffel Tower cost a fortune to keep up.
shots.scene: medium, café table on the Paris street in golden light: Lustig holds up a newspaper, its front page faces us (a drawing of the tower, a coral cost line climbing on "cost a fortune"); he lowers it on "keep up", smirking

shots.line: He had letters printed with the French government's seal.
shots.scene: insert: a 1920s platen press slams on "printed", a letterhead with the red-and-gold government seal slides onto a growing stack; the seal glints on "seal"

shots.line: He set himself up at the Hôtel de Crillon,
shots.scene: establishing: the Crillon's colonnaded stone facade at night, lit windows, a doorman; Lustig walks up to the entrance; readout HOTEL DE CRILLON on "Crillon"

shots.line: a palace of a hotel on the Place de la Concorde.
shots.scene: wide pull-out: the Place de la Concorde at night, the obelisk and a fountain, lamp posts, the hotel behind, the lit tower small in the distance

shots.line: And he wrote to the top men in France's scrap-metal trade,
shots.scene: medium, hotel suite at night: Lustig writes at a desk by the tall window (the tower far off), green lamp; sealed envelopes stack up

shots.line: inviting them to a meeting.
shots.scene: blueprint diagram: an envelope icon at the centre splits into envelopes that fly out along dotted lines to a ring of dealer heads, one with a yellow cap

shots.line: In a quiet room, he told them the tower had to come down:
shots.scene: establishing: the hotel meeting room, tall windows with the night tower view, long table, dealers seated (Poisson's yellow cap), Lustig standing at the head on the left; he chops his hand down on "come down"

shots.line: costly repairs, and political problems he could not discuss.
shots.scene: medium over the dealers' blurred heads: Lustig by an easel with a tower drawing, coral marks pop on it on "costly repairs"; he turns, leans in and looks side to side on "could not discuss"

shots.line: It would go to the highest bidder.
shots.scene: giant face Poisson, awe -> determined; gold glints in his eyes on "highest bidder"; slow push; fade out
